conversion.pipeline: STEP AP214 XCAF assembly -> absolute-deflection OpenCascade tessellation -> depth-2 system grouping -> complexity-weighted VTK quadric decimation -> degenerate removal -> feature-aware normals -> glTF 2.0 Meshopt LODs
conversion.decimation: VTK quadric with volume preservation and system-complexity budgets
conversion.compression: glTF-Transform 4.4.2 Meshopt high; position 16 bits; normal 12 bits

coverage.qualityBoundary: The high LOD improves visual tessellation and surface shading only; neither LOD contains B-Rep surfaces or engineering dimensional authority.

disclaimer: Authorized public simplified visualization derivative only. It is not an engineering authority and must not be used for manufacturing, dimensional verification, physics calculation, CAE analysis, configuration control, safety decisions or reverse engineering of the private source CAD.
